integrity: The theorem is derived from the published coexistence-boundary parametrization by an explicit change of variables and elementary integration. Numerical replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the small-\(r\) genus-zero five-vertex family with \(\alpha_i\beta_j<1\) for every pair, in the source slope coordinates. It does not identify Gibbs-state mixtures inside coexistence and does not address mixed or large-\(r\) weights.
title: A cellwise averaging law for five-vertex coexistence area
